description: The executable realizable-row test accepts an actual quantifier-free ground formula exactly when it has a nonempty first-order model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.groundTest_correct.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Relations n)] (A : L.Sentence)
  (hA : FirstOrder.Language.BoundedFormula.IsQF A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.groundTest A = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.QuantifierFreeValidity.GroundHasModel A
